description: This file defines the ApplyTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing 'apply' tags that apply filters to sections of templates.

classes.name: Twig	okenparser\ApplyTokenParser
classes.description: Final class that parses 'apply' tags in Twig templates, creating nodes that apply filters to template sections.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an 'apply' block in the template, returning a set of nodes that represent the filtered section.

methods.name: decideApplyEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token marks the end of an 'apply' block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser ('apply').
